mockup_fidelity_rule.law: Any building/prop/character sourced from MOCKUP_SSOT_V2 (or successor) must visually match that mockup 100% (silhouette/palette/key details) via headed screenshot evidence before its wave can close. Approximate match = CHANGES_REQUESTED, never a quiet close.
mockup_fidelity_rule.redo_loop: A mismatch is fixed and re-checked in a loop (iterate to match), not disclosed-and-stopped. Only 3 identical failure signatures on the SAME object route to NEED_HUMAN.
mockup_fidelity_rule.principle: AI design-build parity guarantee (Human-mandated 2026-07-24): the ability to produce a mockup and the ability to build the identical product in-game are one design capability, not two separate ones with separate standards. This is what actually guarantees AI design quality. The 100% fidelity law below is this principle made checkable, not an arbitrary gate. Applies to any AI agent, this project or any future one.
